verdicts.originalText: The +25% Anemo DMG Bonus fires when Venti picks up an Elemental Orb/Particle while active on-field. Particle generation and pickup are out of scope per the tool constitution — the planner doesn't simulate orb collection. Toggle this buff on for canonical rotations that path Venti through particles.
verdicts.proposedText: Orb and particle pickup aren't simulated, so this doesn't fire on its own — toggle it on for rotations that pick up particles.
verdicts.rationale: Manual-trigger buff whose trigger (orb/particle pickup) is on the CANNOT list (pickup-driven empowerment, out of scope by constitution) — a real permanent gap, so rewrite, not implementDelete or FROZEN. Compressed to the two user-relevant facts: pickup isn't simulated, so the buff must be toggled on. Applied the wave-3 authored-manual-trigger phrasing ('doesn't fire on its own'). Dropped both names (shown in the panel), the +25% value (renders on the buff bar once toggled), and the on-field nuance (demoted). 'not simulated' preserves the 'doesn't simulate orb collection' claim; 'out of scope per the tool constitution' is justification, not a distinct mechanical claim.

claimsLost.claim: fires only while Venti is the active on-field character at pickup

demotedNotes: Original user text noted the C4 buff fires only while Venti is active on-field at pickup; dropped from the rewrite as a minor nuance since the buff is a manual toggle regardless of on-field state.
